import numpy as np

def compute_kappa(annotations, num_categories=5):
    n = len(annotations)
    agreements = sum(1 for a, b in annotations if a == b)
    p_o = agreements / n
    counts = np.bincount([a for a, b in annotations] + [b for a, b in annotations], minlength=num_categories)
    probs = counts / (2 * n)
    p_e = np.sum(probs ** 2)
    kappa = (p_o - p_e) / (1 - p_e + 1e-10)
    return kappa
